title: Moesha
description:
S4 E1 — Moesha Meets Brandy
Moesha meets Brandy at a concert and we discover that Moesha is having a romance with Aaron, a college student.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E2 — Homecoming
With a little help from Myles and a visit from Grandma Mitchell, Moesha moves back home and returns to Crenshaw High.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E3 — Hello! What’s This?
Dee finds a joint in the couch while cleaning the house.  Frank and Dee assume and accuse Mo, but Moesha is shocked when she catches Myles smoking.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E4 — Psyche Your Mind
Based on the family turmoil, the family begins counseling, but Moesha doesn’t want to air the family’s 'dirty laundry'.

S2 E16 — Rich Kid
Mary takes a stand against the deadly drug, crack when she discovers that a wealthy and generous new friend of Calvin and Brenda is selling the drug.

S2 E17 — A Matter Of Choice
Lester wins a major contracting bid, which enables the Jenkins' to begin looking for their dream home when Lester discovers that the backers of the construction job are involved in South African investments.

S2 E18 — Happy Twentieth
Plans made by Mary (Marla Gibbs) and Lester (Hal Williams) to celebrate their 20th wedding anniversary result in disharmony when quarreling in-laws come to town.

S2 E19 — Toyland
Guest star Pee Wee Herman plays himself in this special episode in which he, Mary (Marla Gibbs), Lester (Hal Williams) and Sandra (Jackée) are held captive in a toy store and must resort to more than pop guns and bows and arrows to set themselves free.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E4 — Partnership Of Fools
Malcolm and Eddie use their lottery winnings to buy their building from Kelly.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E5 — Someday My TAFKAP Will Come
Eddie arranges for the Artist Formerly Known as Prince to appear at Kelly's re-opening party.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E6 — Little Sister
Eddie is determined to keep Malcolm away from his younger sister.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E7 — Big Brother Is Watching
Eddie agrees to spend time with a ten-year-old boy in order to date a beautiful woman.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E8 — The Boy Who Cried Werewolf
Eddie fears a family curse will make him a werewolf on Halloween.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E24 — Rated X
Fred, Lamont and Rollo almost become stars in an X-rated movie until they are faced with the 'naked' truth and the wrath of Esther.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E1 — Crossed Swords
Lamont discovers that the porcelain figure he has bought is worth a great deal of money and decides auctioning off the piece will bring the best price. Fred's actions as a shill backfire, shattering Lamont's chance for freedom...and the statue.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E2 — Happy Birthday, Pop
Fred's 65th birthday is anything but happy when his first Social Security check and Lamont's 'night on the town' don't meet his expectations.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E3 — Here Comes The Bride There Goes The Bride
Fred's protest against Lamont's impending marriage fails to change his son's mind. But as the ceremony begins, the bride-to-be changes her mind, leaving Lamont standing at the altar and haggling with his relatives over their wedding gifts.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E4 — The Copper Caper
Fred's suspicions about a used-copper salesman are ignored by Lamont, especially after his son checks the metal's going price. But unfortunately for everyone, Fred's instincts prove to be correct. The copper Lamont bought was stolen.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E5 — A Matter Of Life And Breath
Lamont and Fred, at Lamont's insistence, take advantage of the free tests offered by a Breathmobile. The results convince Fred that he has tuberculosis.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E21 — Every Night Fever
An evening out at the disco turns into 'every night fever' when George stretches a good thing a bit too far. Louise's frustration grows when she realizes that she is to blame.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E22 — Three Faces Of Florence
Florence's efforts to make herself more 'interesting' backfire when her new suitor turns out to be a psychiatrist -- and 'interesting' Florence is one of the worst cases he's seen. George and Louise are worried over Florence's condition.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E23 — Louise's Convention
There's foul play afoot when George tries to duck out of celebrating his wedding anniversary with Louise and she tries to duck out of town to attend a convention.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E24 — The Freeze-In
When a sudden cold spell throws the Jeffersons, the Willises, Florence, and Mr. Bentley into one crowded apartment, the only things heating up are their tempers.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E3 — Once A Friend
George is seeing an old navy buddy, but is it a man or a woman? Louise is suspicious and George is confused.
